event.description: Union closest block-0 pre-FF norm scales 2 and 8
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,673 parameters at 99.040000%, a +0.040000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 36 prior macro-attempts in this family and 445 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0094/micro-0001 at 1673 parameters and 99.040000%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0093/micro-0010 (discard, 98.960000%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of block 0's pre-feed-forward normalization scales: union coordinates 2 and 8, values 0.4266473353 and 0.4341307580 (difference 7.483e-03), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: upstream nonlinear normalization has local scale redundancy distinct from final normalization, preserving qualification at 1,672 parameters. It is more informative than the next scale union (difference 1.299e-02) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated scale test; biases remain independent. Official acceptance and rollback are unchanged.
